<main id="main">

<section id="finding" aria-labelledby="h-finding">
<div class="wrap">
  <h2 id="h-finding">The finding</h2>
  <div class="grid2">
    <div>
      <p class="q">Can you tell whether a first-order logic formula says what its sentence says, with no gold formula to compare against?</p>
      <p class="measure">Ask several independent LLM families to translate the same sentence. Then count how many of those translations a <button type="button" class="term" data-term="z3">satisfiability solver</button> proves equivalent to the candidate, after lining up predicate names. The share that <em>disagree</em> is the <button type="button" class="term" data-term="cscore">cross-family consensus score</button>. Correct translations tend to agree with each other; wrong ones scatter.</p>
      <p class="measure">In a <button type="button" class="term" data-term="prereg">pre-registered</button> test on 2,686 real candidates for 292 sentences (<button type="button" class="term" data-term="rab">R<sub>AB</sub></button>), consensus beat the prompted Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite judge on <button type="button" class="term" data-term="strat">stratified AUROC</button> by</p>
      <p class="bignum" id="big-delta" aria-describedby="big-cap"></p>
      <p class="bignum-cap" id="big-cap"></p>
      <p class="measure note">Dataset E was frozen before this test but later reused for metric selection, so the paper treats these as development-set results. The matching test on the fresh set E2 was stopped by budget.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="panel">
      <p class="q" style="margin-bottom:8px">Does consensus stay ahead of the judges in every part of the data?</p>
      <div class="controls">
        <fieldset>
          <legend>Stratum</legend>
          <div class="seg" id="f-strat" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Stratum">
            <label><input type="radio" name="fstrat" value="ALL" checked><span>All (stratified)</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" name="fstrat" value="L25"><span>L25</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" name="fstrat" value="L20"><span>L20</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" name="fstrat" value="EXC"><span>EXC</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" name="fstrat" value="CTRL"><span>CTRL</span></label>
          </div>
        </fieldset>
        <label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="f-tierA"> Tier A labels only</label>
      </div>
      <ul class="legend" aria-hidden="true">
        <li><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>consensus-based</li>
        <li><span class="sw" style="background:var(--base-dark)"></span>pre-registered judge bar</li>
        <li><span class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></span>other baselines and judges</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="chart" id="c-finding" role="group" aria-label="Error-detection AUROC by metric"></div>
      <p class="note" id="f-n"></p>
      <p class="takeaway" id="f-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="how" aria-labelledby="h-how">
<div class="wrap">
  <h2 id="h-how">How it works</h2>
  <p class="q">What happens to one candidate between the sentence and its score?</p>
  <p class="measure">Below is one real sentence from dataset E and its recorded candidates. Pick which candidate to score and step through the three stages the paper describes (peer generation, pairwise solver verification, scoring), plus how to read the result. The per-peer verdicts come from the recorded pairwise Z3 matrix; the score at the end is recomputed from them and checked against the frozen score stored in the run.</p>
  <div class="panel" id="stepper" aria-roledescription="stepper">
    <div class="controls">
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Candidate to score</legend>
        <div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Candidate to score">
          <label><input type="radio" name="scand" value="err" checked><span>A wrong translation</span></label>
          <label><input type="radio" name="scand" value="cor"><span>A correct translation</span></label>
        </div>
      </fieldset>
    </div>
    <div class="pipeline chart" id="pipeline" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div class="stepper-nav">
      <button type="button" class="plain" id="s-prev">&larr; Previous</button>
      <ol class="markers" id="s-markers" aria-label="Stages"></ol>
      <button type="button" class="plain" id="s-next">Next &rarr;</button>
    </div>
    <p class="sr-only" id="s-live" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <h3 id="s-title" style="margin-top:8px"></h3>
    <div class="stage" id="s-body" tabindex="-1"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="s-take"></p>
  </div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="evidence" aria-labelledby="h-evidence">
<div class="wrap">
  <h2 id="h-evidence">Explore the evidence</h2>

  <h3 id="h-cx">Does the gap grow with sentence complexity?</h3>
  <p class="q">Long, heavily conditioned sentences are where evaluation matters most. Is that where consensus helps?</p>
  <div class="panel">
    <div class="controls">
      <label class="field"><span>Split candidates by</span>
        <select id="cx-dim">
          <option value="words">Sentence length (words)</option>
          <option value="ncond">Number of conditions</option>
          <option value="nquant">Number of quantifiers</option>
          <option value="depth">Nesting depth</option>
          <option value="exc">Exception type</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label class="field"><span>Compare consensus with</span>
        <select id="cx-base">
          <option value="jd">Flash-Lite judge (disguised)</option>
          <option value="jo">Flash-Lite judge (original)</option>
          <option value="no">GPT-4.1-Nano judge (original)</option>
          <option value="q8">Local Qwen3-8B judge (disguised)</option>
          <option value="sc">Self-consistency (SC-5)</option>
          <option value="rt">Round-trip NLI</option>
        </select>
      </label>
    </div>
    <ul class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><li><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>Cross-family consensus</li><li><span class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></span><span id="cx-base-name">baseline</span></li></ul>
    <div class="chart" id="c-cx" role="group" aria-label="AUROC by complexity bin"></div>
    <p class="note">Pooled AUROC within each bin, computed live from the 2,686 recorded scores; bins with fewer than 10 errors or 10 correct candidates are drawn but marked as thin. Bin edges follow the run's analysis script.</p>
    <p class="takeaway" id="cx-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <h3 id="h-browser">Open any candidate</h3>
  <p class="q">What does a flagged candidate look like next to the peers that disagree with it?</p>
  <div class="panel">
    <div class="controls">
      <label class="field"><span>Label</span><select id="b-label"><option value="all">All</option><option value="1">ERROR</option><option value="0">CORRECT</option></select></label>
      <label class="field"><span>Stratum</span><select id="b-strat"><option value="all">All</option><option>L25</option><option>L20</option><option>EXC</option><option>CTRL</option></select></label>
      <label class="field"><span>Consensus vs judge</span><select id="b-agree">
        <option value="all">Any</option>
        <option value="cOnly">Only consensus flags it</option>
        <option value="jOnly">Only the judge flags it</option>
        <option value="both">Both flag it</option>
        <option value="none">Neither flags it</option>
      </select></label>
      <label class="field"><span>Error type</span><select id="b-op"><option value="all">Any</option></select></label>
      <label class="field"><span>Sort</span><select id="b-sort">
        <option value="c-desc">Consensus score, high first</option>
        <option value="c-asc">Consensus score, low first</option>
        <option value="gap">Consensus minus judge, largest first</option>
        <option value="words">Longest sentence first</option>
      </select></label>

          <option value="wt:T1">Shortest third by words</option><option value="wt:T2">Middle third by words</option><option value="wt:T3">Longest third by words</option>
          <option value="nc:0-1">0 to 1 conditions</option><option value="nc:2">2 conditions</option><option value="nc:3">3 conditions</option><option value="nc:4+">4 or more conditions</option>

    <div class="stat-row" id="m-stats"></div>
    <p class="note">One value per sentence: the <button type="button" class="term" data-term="si">scatter index</button>, the share of cross-family candidate pairs with the same label that Z3 proves equivalent. Read from the per-sentence table of the mechanism audit.</p>

        <div class="chart" id="c-roc" role="group" aria-label="ROC curves with the current operating point"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

        <label><input type="radio" name="fmode" value="rejected"><span>Correct candidates peers reject</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>
    <div class="stat-row" id="x-stats"></div>
    <div class="controls">
      <label class="field"><span>Break down by</span>
        <select id="x-dim"><option value="words_tercile">Sentence-length third</option><option value="ncond_bin">Number of conditions</option><option value="stratum">Stratum</option></select>
      </label>
    </div>
    <ul class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><li><span class="sw" style="background:var(--err)"></span>error endorsement e</li><li><span class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>correct-item divergence d</li></ul>
    <div class="chart" id="c-ed" role="group" aria-label="Endorsement and divergence rates by complexity"></div>
    <p class="note">Bars: <button type="button" class="term" data-term="e">e</button> and <button type="button" class="term" data-term="d">d</button> for majority-vote consensus with 9 families, as recorded by the mechanism audit (2,672 scorable R<sub>AB</sub> rows). The counts above are recomputed live from the 2,686 recorded scores (endorsed = consensus score below 0.5, meaning a majority of peers agree).</p>
    <h4>Five real cases of this failure</h4>
    <ul class="peerlist" id="x-examples"></ul>
    <p class="takeaway" id="x-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
  <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>
  <ul class="limits measure">
    <li><strong>Renaming breaks the aligner.</strong> The name-similarity aligner fails on synonym substitutions and nonce renamings: false-alarm rates rise from 0.18 to 0.87 under WordNet-synonym renaming on dataset E. Name-free alignment lowers AUROC by 0.05 to 0.10 because it over-accepts granularity differences. The paper calls this the method's most significant open weakness.</li>
    <li><strong>Errors every family makes are invisible.</strong> About 12.4% of erroneous translations on dataset E are endorsed by a majority of peers (e = 0.124). Consensus cannot detect them by definition.</li>
    <li><strong>No advantage on short sentences.</strong> On the CTRL stratum the delta against the judge is &minus;0.069 [&minus;0.232, +0.098].</li>
    <li><strong>Labels move the numbers.</strong> The consensus-vs-judge delta shifts by 0.02 to 0.10 depending on whether labels come from the solver alone, the solver plus panel, or all tiers.</li>
    <li><strong>The panel is strict.</strong> It accepts only 61% of expert-corrected formulas and rejects 82% of MALLS gold annotations, so ERROR is over-called.</li>
    <li><strong>Confirmation on fresh data is partial.</strong> The pre-registered E2 test was budget-stopped after 110 of 550 sentences. On that prefix consensus ties a local 8B judge (0.890 vs 0.913, delta +0.003 [&minus;0.042, +0.052]).</li>
  </ul>

const C = { accent: '#1d5fb8', base: '#9aa2ac', baseDark: '#5d6670', err: '#c4520f', cor: '#0b7a5a', ink: '#1b1f24', ink2: '#4a525c', grid: '#e9ebee', muted: '#6b737d' };

R.forEach((r, i) => { r.i = i; r.sent = S[r.s]; r.st = r.sent.stratum; r.me = r.sent.rows[r.r]; });

const METRICS = [
  { k: 'c', name: 'Cross-family consensus', kind: 'cons' },
  { k: 'pt', name: 'PEER+TEXT (fused)', kind: 'cons' },
  { k: 's4c', name: 'S4 + consensus', kind: 'cons' },
  { k: 's4', name: 'Stacked baselines (S4)', kind: 'base' },
  { k: 'q8', name: 'Local Qwen3-8B judge (disguised)', kind: 'base' },
  { k: 'no', name: 'GPT-4.1-Nano judge (original)', kind: 'base' },
  { k: 'jd', name: 'Flash-Lite judge (disguised)', kind: 'bar' },
  { k: 'jo', name: 'Flash-Lite judge (original)', kind: 'base' },
  { k: 'rt', name: 'Round-trip NLI', kind: 'base' },
  { k: 'sc', name: 'Self-consistency (SC-5)', kind: 'base' }
];
const MNAME = Object.fromEntries(METRICS.map(m => [m.k, m.name]));
const colorOf = kind => kind === 'cons' ? C.accent : kind === 'bar' ? C.baseDark : C.base;

/* ---------- statistics ---------- */
function auroc(rows, key) {
  const a = [];
  let n1 = 0, n0 = 0;
  for (const r of rows) { const v = r[key]; if (v == null) continue; a.push([v, r.y]); if (r.y) n1++; else n0++; }
  if (!n1 || !n0) return null;
  a.sort((p, q) => p[0] - q[0]);
  let rs = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length;) {
    let j = i;
    while (j + 1 < a.length && a[j + 1][0] === a[i][0]) j++;
    const rk = (i + j) / 2 + 1;
    for (let k = i; k <= j; k++) if (a[k][1]) rs += rk;
    i = j + 1;
  }
  return (rs - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0);
}
function stratAuroc(rows, key) {
  let num = 0, den = 0;
  for (const h of STRATA) {
    const sub = rows.filter(r => r.st === h);
    const n1 = sub.filter(r => r.y).length, n0 = sub.length - n1;
    if (n1 && n0) { num += auroc(sub, key) * n1 * n0; den += n1 * n0; }
  }
  return den ? num / den : null;
}
const f3 = v => v == null ? 'n/a' : v.toFixed(3);
const sgn = v => v == null ? 'n/a' : (v >= 0 ? '+' : '−') + Math.abs(v).toFixed(3);
const pct = v => v == null ? 'n/a' : (100 * v).toFixed(1) + '%';
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]));
const ciTxt = ci => '[' + sgn(ci[0]) + ', ' + sgn(ci[1]) + ']';
const ciTxtU = ci => '[' + f3(ci[0]) + ', ' + f3(ci[1]) + ']';

/* ---------- chart tooltip ---------- */
const tip = $('#chart-tip');
let tipOwner = null;
function showTip(node, html) {
  tip.innerHTML = html; tip.classList.add('on'); tipOwner = node;
  const b = node.getBoundingClientRect();
  const tw = tip.offsetWidth, th = tip.offsetHeight;
  let x = b.left + b.width / 2 - tw / 2;
  x = Math.max(8, Math.min(x, window.innerWidth - tw - 8));
  let y = b.top - th - 8;
  if (y < 8) y = b.bottom + 8;
  tip.style.left = x + 'px'; tip.style.top = y + 'px';
}
function hideTip() { tip.classList.remove('on'); tipOwner = null; }
function bindMark(node, html, aria) {
  node.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  node.setAttribute('role', 'img');
  node.setAttribute('aria-label', aria);
  node.classList.add('mark');
  node.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => showTip(node, html));
  node.addEventListener('pointerleave', e => { if (e.pointerType === 'mouse') hideTip(); });
  node.addEventListener('focus', () => showTip(node, html));
  node.addEventListener('blur', hideTip);
  node.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); showTip(node, html); });
}
document.addEventListener('click', () => { if (tipOwner) hideTip(); });
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (tipOwner) hideTip(); }, { passive: true });

/* ---------- svg helpers ---------- */
function el(tag, attrs, parent) {
  const n = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, tag);
  for (const k in attrs) n.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
  if (parent) parent.appendChild(n);
  return n;
}
function txt(parent, x, y, s, attrs) {
  const t = el('text', Object.assign({ x, y, 'font-size': 12, fill: C.ink2 }, attrs || {}), parent);
  t.textContent = s; return t;
}
function newSvg(container, w, h, title) {
  container.innerHTML = '';
  const svg = el('svg', { viewBox: `0 0 ${w} ${h}`, width: w, height: h, role: 'group' });
  if (title) { const t = el('title', {}, svg); t.textContent = title; }
  container.appendChild(svg);
  return svg;
}
const redrawers = [];
function onResize(container, fn) {
  redrawers.push(fn);
  if (window.ResizeObserver) {
    let last = container.clientWidth;
    new ResizeObserver(() => { const w = container.clientWidth; if (Math.abs(w - last) > 4) { last = w; fn(); } }).observe(container);
  }
}

/* Horizontal bar chart. groups: [{label, bars:[{value, color, ci, tip, aria, name}] , sub}] ; bars start at 0 */
function hbars(container, groups, opt) {
  opt = opt || {};
  const W = Math.max(280, container.clientWidth);
  const barH = opt.barH || 16, gap = 3, labelH = 18, groupGap = 12;
  const padL = 4, padR = 44, top = 4;
  const xMax = opt.xMax || 1;
  let h = top;
  groups.forEach(g => { h += labelH + g.bars.length * (barH + gap) + groupGap; });
  const axisH = 40;
  const H = h + axisH;
  const svg = newSvg(container, W, H, opt.title);
  const plotW = W - padL - padR;
  const X = v => padL + (Math.max(0, Math.min(v, xMax)) / xMax) * plotW;
  // gridlines
  const ticks = opt.ticks || [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1];
  ticks.forEach(t => {
    el('line', { x1: X(t), x2: X(t), y1: top, y2: h, stroke: C.grid, 'stroke-width': 1 }, svg);
    txt(svg, X(t), h + 16, opt.tickFmt ? opt.tickFmt(t) : String(t), { 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 11, fill: C.muted });
  });
  if (opt.ref != null) {
    el('line', { x1: X(opt.ref), x2: X(opt.ref), y1: top, y2: h, stroke: C.ink2, 'stroke-dasharray': '4 3', 'stroke-width': 1.2 }, svg);
  }
  txt(svg, padL + plotW / 2, h + 34, opt.xLabel || '', { 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 12, fill: C.ink2 });
  let y = top;
  groups.forEach(g => {
    const gl = txt(svg, padL, y + 13, g.label, { 'font-size': 13, fill: C.ink, 'font-weight': g.bold ? 700 : 500 });
    if (g.sub) { const ts = el('tspan', { fill: C.muted, 'font-weight': 400, 'font-size': 11.5 }, gl); ts.textContent = '  ' + g.sub; }
    y += labelH;
    g.bars.forEach(b => {
      const gg = el('g', {}, svg);
      if (b.value != null) {
        el('rect', { x: X(0), y, width: Math.max(1, X(b.value) - X(0)), height: barH, fill: b.color, rx: 2, opacity: b.faint ? 0.45 : 1 }, gg);
        if (b.ci) {
          const cy = y + barH / 2;
          el('line', { x1: X(b.ci[0]), x2: X(b.ci[1]), y1: cy, y2: cy, stroke: C.ink, 'stroke-width': 1.3 }, gg);
          el('line', { x1: X(b.ci[0]), x2: X(b.ci[0]), y1: cy - 4, y2: cy + 4, stroke: C.ink, 'stroke-width': 1.3 }, gg);
          el('line', { x1: X(b.ci[1]), x2: X(b.ci[1]), y1: cy - 4, y2: cy + 4, stroke: C.ink, 'stroke-width': 1.3 }, gg);
        }
        const vx = Math.max(X(b.value), b.ci ? X(b.ci[1]) : 0) + 4;
        txt(gg, vx, y + barH - 3, (opt.valFmt || f3)(b.value), { 'font-size': 11.5, fill: C.ink, 'font-variant-numeric': 'tabular-nums' });
      } else {
        txt(gg, X(0) + 4, y + barH - 3, 'not testable here', { 'font-size': 11, fill: C.muted });
      }
      // invisible hit area covering the row (at least 40px tall on touch via padding rect)
      el('rect', { x: 0, y: y - 2, width: W, height: barH + 4, fill: 'transparent' }, gg);
      bindMark(gg, b.tip, b.aria);
      y += barH + gap;
    });
    y += groupGap;
  });
  return svg;
}

/* Line chart: xs numeric, series [{name,color,values,dash,ci:[[lo],[hi]]}] */
function lineChart(container, cfg) {
  const W = Math.max(280, container.clientWidth);
  const H = cfg.height || 300;
  const m = { l: 52, r: 16, t: 12, b: 48 };
  const svg = newSvg(container, W, H, cfg.title);
  const pw = W - m.l - m.r, ph = H - m.t - m.b;
  const [x0, x1] = cfg.xDomain, [y0, y1] = cfg.yDomain;
  const X = v => m.l + (v - x0) / (x1 - x0) * pw;
  const Y = v => m.t + ph - (v - y0) / (y1 - y0) * ph;
  cfg.yTicks.forEach(t => {
    el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l + pw, y1: Y(t), y2: Y(t), stroke: C.grid }, svg);
    txt(svg, m.l - 6, Y(t) + 4, cfg.yFmt ? cfg.yFmt(t) : String(t), { 'text-anchor': 'end', 'font-size': 11, fill: C.muted });
  });
  cfg.xTicks.forEach(t => {
    txt(svg, X(t), m.t + ph + 16, cfg.xFmt ? cfg.xFmt(t) : String(t), { 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 11, fill: C.muted });
  });
  el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l + pw, y1: m.t + ph, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: C.ink2 }, svg);
  el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l, y1: m.t, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: C.ink2 }, svg);
  txt(svg, m.l + pw / 2, H - 8, cfg.xLabel, { 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 12 });
  const yl = txt(svg, 0, 0, cfg.yLabel, { 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 12, transform: `translate(14 ${m.t + ph / 2}) rotate(-90)` });
  if (cfg.diag) el('line', { x1: X(x0), y1: Y(y0), x2: X(x1), y2: Y(y1), stroke: C.ink2, 'stroke-dasharray': '4 3' }, svg);
  cfg.series.forEach(s => {
    if (s.ci) {
      let d = '';
      s.xs.forEach((x, i) => { d += (i ? 'L' : 'M') + X(x) + ' ' + Y(s.ci[1][i]); });
      for (let i = s.xs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) d += 'L' + X(s.xs[i]) + ' ' + Y(s.ci[0][i]);
      el('path', { d: d + 'Z', fill: s.color, opacity: 0.13 }, svg);
    }
    let d = '';
    s.xs.forEach((x, i) => { d += (i ? 'L' : 'M') + X(x) + ' ' + Y(s.values[i]); });
    el('path', { d, fill: 'none', stroke: s.color, 'stroke-width': s.width || 2.2, 'stroke-dasharray': s.dash || '' }, svg);
    if (s.points) s.xs.forEach((x, i) => {
      const g = el('g', {}, svg);
      el('circle', { cx: X(x), cy: Y(s.values[i]), r: s.r ? s.r(i) : 4, fill: s.fill ? s.fill(i) : '#fff', stroke: s.color, 'stroke-width': 2 }, g);
      el('circle', { cx: X(x), cy: Y(s.values[i]), r: 14, fill: 'transparent' }, g);
      bindMark(g, s.tip(i), s.aria(i));
    });
  });
  if (cfg.markers) cfg.markers.forEach(mk => {
    const g = el('g', {}, svg);
    el('circle', { cx: X(mk.x), cy: Y(mk.y), r: 7, fill: mk.color, stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 2 }, g);
    el('circle', { cx: X(mk.x), cy: Y(mk.y), r: 16, fill: 'transparent' }, g);
    bindMark(g, mk.tip, mk.aria);
  });
  return svg;
}

/* Vertical grouped bars: bins [{label}], series [{name,color,values}] */
function vbars(container, cfg) {
  const W = Math.max(280, container.clientWidth);
  const H = cfg.height || 260;
  const m = { l: 46, r: 8, t: 10, b: 50 };
  const svg = newSvg(container, W, H, cfg.title);
  const pw = W - m.l - m.r, ph = H - m.t - m.b;
  const yMax = cfg.yMax;
  const Y = v => m.t + ph - v / yMax * ph;
  cfg.yTicks.forEach(t => {
    el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l + pw, y1: Y(t), y2: Y(t), stroke: C.grid }, svg);
    txt(svg, m.l - 6, Y(t) + 4, cfg.yFmt(t), { 'text-anchor': 'end', 'font-size': 11, fill: C.muted });
  });
  const nb = cfg.bins.length, ns = cfg.series.length;
  const bw = pw / nb, inner = bw * 0.8 / ns;
  cfg.bins.forEach((b, i) => {
    const cx = m.l + i * bw + bw / 2;
    if (W > 420 || i % 2 === 0) txt(svg, cx, m.t + ph + 15, b, { 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 10.5, fill: C.muted });
    cfg.series.forEach((s, j) => {
      const v = s.values[i];
      const x = m.l + i * bw + bw * 0.1 + j * inner;
      const g = el('g', {}, svg);
      el('rect', { x, y: Y(v), width: Math.max(1, inner - 1), height: Math.max(0, Y(0) - Y(v)), fill: s.color, rx: 1.5 }, g);
      el('rect', { x, y: m.t, width: inner, height: ph, fill: 'transparent' }, g);
      bindMark(g, cfg.tip(i, j), cfg.aria(i, j));
    });
  });
  el('line', { x1: m.l, x2: m.l + pw, y1: Y(0), y2: Y(0), stroke: C.ink2 }, svg);
  txt(svg, m.l + pw / 2, H - 10, cfg.xLabel, { 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 12 });
  txt(svg, 0, 0, cfg.yLabel, { 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': 12, transform: `translate(13 ${m.t + ph / 2}) rotate(-90)` });
  return svg;
}

/* ---------- glossary + term popovers ---------- */
const GLOSS = {
  nlfol: ['NL-to-FOL', 'Translating a natural-language sentence into a first-order logic formula.'],
  cscore: ['Cross-family consensus score (c-score)', 'The fraction of peer translations from other LLM families that are not solver-equivalent to the candidate after predicate-name alignment: c-score(c) = 1 − |{p ∈ P : eq(c, p)}| / |P|. Higher means more likely wrong.'],
  peers: ['Peer pool', 'The translations of the same sentence produced independently by k LLM families (one model per family, few-shot, temperature 0). The candidate is excluded from its own pool (leave-one-out), and so are rows of its own family.'],
  align: ['Predicate alignment', 'An injective, arity-respecting mapping from the candidate’s predicates to a peer’s predicates, chosen by normalized edit distance between names. Unmatched predicates stay unaligned.'],
  z3: ['Z3 solver equivalence', 'A pair is equivalent if, after alignment, the Z3 check returns unsatisfiable for both c ⇒ p′ and p′ ⇒ c, where p′ is the aligned peer.'],
  auroc: ['AUROC', 'The probability that a randomly chosen erroneous candidate gets a higher (more suspicious) score than a randomly chosen correct one. 0.5 is chance, 1 is perfect.'],
  strat: ['Stratified AUROC', 'AUROC that counts only error–correct pairs from the same source stratum, controlling for stratum-level difficulty differences.'],
  rab: ['R_AB population', 'The primary evaluation population: dataset E candidates with tier A or tier B labels, 2,686 candidates (1,822 errors, 864 correct) for 292 sentences.'],
  tier: ['Label tiers A, B, C', 'Tier A: a Z3 solver checks equivalence to the gold or panel-repaired reference. Tier B: a blind, nonce-disguised panel of three LLMs adjudicates vocabulary-granularity and compound mismatches. Tier C: no trusted reference, unresolved.'],
  strata: ['Strata L25, L20, EXC, CTRL', 'L25: at least 25 words and 3 conditions. L20: at least 20 words. EXC: exception clauses using unless, except or without. CTRL: short FOLIO-train sentences.'],
  disg: ['Disguised judge view', 'The judge sees the formula with nonce-renamed predicates, a control for contamination from public gold annotations. The original view uses the real names.'],
  prereg: ['Pre-registration', 'The consensus score, judge prompt, population, bootstrap procedure and success criterion were frozen and hashed before any held-out score was computed.'],
  boot: ['Sentence-clustered bootstrap', 'Confidence intervals are percentile bootstrap intervals over resampled sentences (B = 2,000), so candidates of the same sentence move together.'],
  pt: ['PEER+TEXT', 'The consensus score combined with two text-based checks (content accounting L2-bow and the role questionnaire L3) through a logistic model fitted on a development screen and frozen before the held-out test.'],
  s4: ['S4 stacked baselines', 'A cross-fitted logistic stack of all 28 individual baselines, including every judge, round-trip and self-consistency.'],
  sc5: ['Self-consistency (SC-5)', 'Five temperature-0.7 samples from GPT-4.1-Nano, scored by the Z3 equivalence fraction.'],
  rt: ['Round-trip NLI', 'The formula is verbalized back into English and compared with the sentence by an NLI model (DeBERTa).'],
  e: ['Error endorsement e', 'The rate at which peers agree with an incorrect candidate; under majority vote, the share of errors that a majority of peers endorse.'],
  d: ['Correct-item divergence d', 'The rate at which peers disagree with a correct candidate; under majority vote, the share of correct candidates that a majority of peers do not endorse. Binary majority AUROC is 1 − (e + d)/2.'],
  si: ['Scatter index', 'For one sentence, the share of cross-family pairs of candidates with the same label that Z3 proves equivalent: 1 means every such pair agrees, 0 means none do.'],
  wb: ['Within-base AUROC', 'On the perturbation suite, the probability that a mutant of a given base formula scores higher than the base itself.'],
  pol: ['DOWN and UP edits', 'Mutant polarity labels: DOWN is removal or weakening, UP is addition or strengthening.']
};
(function buildGlossary() {
  const dl = $('#glossary');
  Object.entries(GLOSS).forEach(([k, [t, d]]) => {
    const dt = document.createElement('dt'); dt.textContent = t; dt.id = 'term-' + k;
    const dd = document.createElement('dd'); dd.textContent = d; dd.id = 'def-' + k;
    dl.appendChild(dt); dl.appendChild(dd);
  });
})();
const pop = $('#term-pop');
let popOwner = null;
function openPop(btn) {
  const k = btn.dataset.term; const g = GLOSS[k]; if (!g) return;
  pop.innerHTML = '<b>' + esc(g[0]) + '</b>' + esc(g[1]);
  pop.classList.add('on'); popOwner = btn; btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  const b = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pw = pop.offsetWidth, ph = pop.offsetHeight;
  let x = Math.max(8, Math.min(b.left, window.innerWidth - pw - 8));
  let y = b.bottom + 6;
  if (y + ph > window.innerHeight - 8) y = Math.max(8, b.top - ph - 6);
  pop.style.left = x + 'px'; pop.style.top = y + 'px';
}
function closePop() { if (popOwner) popOwner.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); pop.classList.remove('on'); popOwner = null; }
function wireTerms(root) {
  $$('button.term', root).forEach(btn => {
    if (btn.dataset.wired) return; btn.dataset.wired = '1';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-describedby', 'def-' + btn.dataset.term);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => openPop(btn));
    btn.addEventListener('focus', () => openPop(btn));
    btn.addEventListener('click', e => { e.stopPropagation(); openPop(btn); });
    btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { if (popOwner === btn) closePop(); });
    btn.addEventListener('blur', () => { if (popOwner === btn) closePop(); });
  });
}
document.addEventListener('click', e => { if (popOwner && !popOwner.contains(e.target)) closePop(); });
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') { closePop(); hideTip(); } });
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (popOwner) closePop(); }, { passive: true });

/* ---------- 1. The finding ---------- */
(function finding() {
  const all = stratAuroc(R, 'c') - stratAuroc(R, 'jd');
  const D = AGG.deltas.ALL;
  $('#big-delta').textContent = sgn(all);
  $('#big-cap').innerHTML = 'stratified AUROC, 95% CI ' + ciTxt(D.ci) + ' (sentence-clustered bootstrap, B = 2,000). Consensus ' + f3(stratAuroc(R, 'c')) + ' vs judge ' + f3(stratAuroc(R, 'jd')) + '.';
  const box = $('#c-finding');
  function draw() {
    const st = $('input[name=fstrat]:checked').value;
    const tierA = $('#f-tierA').checked;
    let rows = R.filter(r => (st === 'ALL' || r.st === st) && (!tierA || r.tier === 'A'));
    const useStrat = st === 'ALL';
    const val = k => useStrat ? stratAuroc(rows, k) : auroc(rows, k);
    const recorded = !tierA ? (st === 'ALL' ? AGG.metrics : null) : null;
    const ne = rows.filter(r => r.y).length, nc = rows.length - ne;
    const groups = METRICS.map(m => {
      const v = val(m.k);
      const ci = recorded ? recorded[m.k].strat_ci : null;
      const lab = m.name;
      return { label: lab, bold: m.k === 'c' || m.k === 'jd', bars: [{ value: v, color: colorOf(m.kind), ci,
        tip: '<b>' + esc(m.name) + '</b><br>' + (useStrat ? 'Stratified' : 'Pooled') + ' AUROC ' + f3(v) + (ci ? '<br>95% CI ' + ciTxtU(ci) : '') + '<br>' + ne + ' errors, ' + nc + ' correct',
        aria: m.name + ': AUROC ' + f3(v) + (ci ? ', 95% CI ' + f3(ci[0]) + ' to ' + f3(ci[1]) : '') }] };
    });
    hbars(box, groups, { xLabel: (useStrat ? 'Stratified' : 'Pooled within-stratum') + ' AUROC for detecting errors (0.5 = chance)', ref: 0.5, title: 'AUROC by metric', barH: 15 });
    $('#f-n').textContent = (tierA ? 'Tier A labels only. ' : '') + rows.length.toLocaleString() + ' candidates (' + ne + ' errors, ' + nc + ' correct) from ' + new Set(rows.map(r => r.s)).size + ' sentences. ' + (recorded ? 'Whiskers: recorded 95% sentence-clustered CIs.' : 'No bootstrap CIs are recorded for this subset; values are computed live.');
    const vc = val('c'), vj = val('jd');
    const others = METRICS.filter(m => m.kind !== 'cons').map(m => [m, val(m.k)]).filter(x => x[1] != null).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    const best = others[0];
    let t = (st === 'ALL' ? 'Across all strata' : 'In stratum ' + st) + (tierA ? ' (tier A only)' : '') + ', consensus scores ' + f3(vc) + ' against ' + f3(vj) + ' for the disguised Flash-Lite judge, a gap of ' + sgn(vc - vj) + '.';
    const recD = !tierA ? AGG.deltas[st] : null;
    if (recD) t += ' The recorded bootstrap CI for that gap is ' + ciTxt(recD.ci) + (recD.ci[0] > 0 ? ', which excludes zero.' : ', which includes zero.');
    if (best) t += ' The strongest non-consensus metric here is ' + best[0].name + ' at ' + f3(best[1]) + (best[1] > vc ? ', above consensus.' : '.');
    $('#f-take').textContent = t;
  }
  $$('input[name=fstrat]').forEach(i => i.addEventListener('change', draw));
  $('#f-tierA').addEventListener('change', draw);
  draw(); onResize(box, draw);
})();

/* ---------- peers helper ---------- */
function isEq(sent, i, j) {
  if (i === j) return true;
  const n = sent.nNodes;
  const a = Math.min(i, j), b = Math.max(i, j);
  return sent.tri[a * n - a * (a + 1) / 2 + (b - a - 1)] === '1';
}
S.forEach(s => {
  let n = 0; while (n * (n - 1) / 2 < s.tri.length) n++;
  s.nNodes = Math.max(n, 1 + Math.max(...s.rows.map(r => r.node)));
});
function peerInfo(sent, me) {
  const list = sent.rows.map(p => {
    let why = null;
    if (p === me) why = 'the candidate itself';
    else if (!p.peer) why = 'gold row, never a peer';
    else if (p.fam === me.fam) why = 'same family as the candidate';
    return { p, why, eq: why ? null : isEq(sent, me.node, p.node) };
  });
  const P = list.filter(x => !x.why);
  const k = P.filter(x => x.eq).length;
  return { list, P, k, c: P.length >= 2 ? 1 - k / P.length : null };
}
const famName = f => ({ openai: 'OpenAI', meta: 'Meta', qwen: 'Qwen', mistral: 'Mistral', deepseek: 'DeepSeek', google: 'Google', microsoft: 'Microsoft', cohere: 'Cohere', symbolic: 'ccg2lambda', gold_as_system_never_peer: 'Gold (as a system)' }[f] || f);
const rowTag = p => famName(p.fam) + ' · ' + p.slot + (p.var === 'zeroshot_v1' ? ' zero-shot' : '');

/* ---------- 2. Stepper ---------- */
(function stepper() {
  const EX_SID = '06b9106bfa46';
  const si = S.findIndex(s => s.id === EX_SID);
  const sent = S[si];
  const recOf = ri => R.find(r => r.s === si && r.r === ri);
  const CAND = { err: 10, cor: 2 };
  const STAGES = ['Input', 'Peer translations', 'Align and check with Z3', 'Score', 'Read the score'];
  let cur = 0;
  const markers = $('#s-markers');
  STAGES.forEach((name, i) => {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = (i + 1) + '. ' + name;
    b.addEventListener('click', () => go(i));
    li.appendChild(b); markers.appendChild(li);
  });
  function drawPipe() {
    const box = $('#pipeline');
    const W = Math.max(280, box.clientWidth);
    const narrow = W < 620;
    const H = narrow ? 5 * 40 + 8 : 84;
    const svg = newSvg(box, W, H, 'Pipeline');
    const names = ['Sentence + candidate', 'Peer translations', 'Align + Z3 check', 'Score 1 − k/|P|', 'Compare with label'];
    names.forEach((n, i) => {
      let x, y, w, h;
      if (narrow) { w = Math.min(W - 8, 300); h = 30; x = 4; y = 4 + i * 40; }
      else { const gap = 22; w = (W - 8 - gap * 4) / 5; h = 52; x = 4 + i * (w + gap); y = 14; }
      const on = i === cur, done = i < cur;
      el('rect', { x, y, width: w, height: h, rx: 8, fill: on ? C.accent : done ? '#dbe7f7' : '#fff', stroke: on ? C.accent : '#b9c0c8', 'stroke-width': 1.5 }, svg);
      txt(svg, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + 4, (i + 1) + '. ' + n, { 'text-anchor': 'middle', 'font-size': narrow ? 12.5 : (w < 130 ? 11 : 12.5), fill: on ? '#fff' : C.ink, 'font-weight': on ? 700 : 500 });
      if (i < 4) {
        if (narrow) el('path', { d: `M${x + 18} ${y + h + 1} l0 8 m-4 -4 l4 4 l4 -4`, stroke: C.muted, fill: 'none' }, svg);
        else el('path', { d: `M${x + w + 3} ${y + h / 2} l15 0 m-5 -5 l5 5 l-5 5`, stroke: C.muted, fill: 'none', 'stroke-width': 1.4 }, svg);
      }
    });
  }
  function render() {
    const which = $('input[name=scand]:checked').value;
    const ri = CAND[which];
    const me = sent.rows[ri];
    const rec = recOf(ri);
    const info = peerInfo(sent, me);
    $$('button', markers).forEach((b, i) => { if (i === cur) b.setAttribute('aria-current', 'step'); else b.removeAttribute('aria-current'); });
    $('#s-prev').disabled = cur === 0; $('#s-next').disabled = cur === STAGES.length - 1;
    $('#s-title').textContent = 'Stage ' + (cur + 1) + ' of ' + STAGES.length + ': ' + STAGES[cur];
    $('#s-live').textContent = 'Stage ' + (cur + 1) + ' of ' + STAGES.length + ': ' + STAGES[cur];
    drawPipe();
    const body = $('#s-body');
    const col = (h, html) => '<div><h4>' + h + '</h4>' + html + '</div>';
    const candBox = '<div class="fol">' + esc(me.fol) + '</div><p class="note">' + esc(rowTag(me)) + '</p>';
    const peerRows = (showEq) => '<ul class="peerlist">' + info.list.map(x => {
      const v = x.why ? '<span class="v out" aria-label="excluded">–</span>' : !showEq ? '<span class="v out" aria-label="peer">?</span>' : x.eq ? '<span class="v yes" aria-label="equivalent">✓</span>' : '<span class="v no" aria-label="not equivalent">✗</span>';
      return '<li class="' + (x.why ? 'dim' : '') + '">' + v + '<div><span style="font-weight:600">' + esc(rowTag(x.p)) + '</span>' + (x.why ? ' <span class="note">(excluded: ' + x.why + ')</span>' : '') + '<div class="fol">' + esc(x.p.fol) + '</div></div></li>';
    }).join('') + '</ul>';
    let html = '', take = '';
    if (cur === 0) {
      html = col('What goes in', '<div class="sent">' + esc(sent.text) + '</div><p class="note">Stratum ' + sent.stratum + ', ' + sent.words + ' words, ' + sent.ncond + ' conditions.</p>')
        + col('The candidate', candBox)
        + col('Why', '<p>The metric sees only the sentence and the formula. There is no gold formula, no ontology and no domain knowledge. The label shown at the last stage is used only to judge the metric, never to compute it.</p>');
      take = 'The ' + (which === 'err' ? 'wrong' : 'correct') + ' candidate from ' + famName(me.fam) + ' enters with nothing but the sentence beside it.';
    } else if (cur === 1) {
      html = col('What is done', '<p>Each other <button type="button" class="term" data-term="peers">peer family</button> translated the same sentence independently (few-shot, temperature 0). Rows from the candidate’s own family and the gold row are left out.</p>')
        + '<div style="grid-column:span 2;min-width:0"><h4>What comes out: ' + info.P.length + ' peers</h4>' + peerRows(false) + '</div>';
      take = info.P.length + ' translations from other families form the peer pool P for this candidate; ' + (info.list.length - info.P.length) + ' rows are excluded.';
    } else if (cur === 2) {
      html = col('What is done', '<p>Peers name predicates differently (<code>PoweredBy(x, electricMotor)</code> against <code>PoweredByElectricMotor(x)</code>), so a raw comparison would reject most pairs. The <button type="button" class="term" data-term="align">aligner</button> maps names by edit distance, respecting arity, and then <button type="button" class="term" data-term="z3">Z3</button> checks implication in both directions.</p><p class="note">The recorded matrix stores the verdict of each check, not the name mapping it used.</p>')
        + '<div style="grid-column:span 2;min-width:0"><h4>What comes out: ' + info.k + ' of ' + info.P.length + ' peers equivalent</h4>' + peerRows(true) + '</div>';
      take = info.k + ' of the ' + info.P.length + ' peers are proved equivalent to the candidate; ' + (info.P.length - info.k) + ' are not.';
    } else if (cur === 3) {
      html = col('What is done', '<p>The score is the share of peers that are <em>not</em> equivalent:</p><p style="font-size:1.1rem">c-score = 1 − k / |P| = 1 − ' + info.k + ' / ' + info.P.length + ' = <b>' + f3(info.c) + '</b></p>')
        + col('Recorded in the run', '<p>Frozen <code>c_score_align</code> for this row: <b>' + f3(rec.c) + '</b>. ' + (Math.abs(rec.c - info.c) < 1e-5 ? 'It matches the value recomputed from the matrix.' : 'It differs from the recomputed value.') + '</p>')
        + col('Why', '<p>Higher scores mean more disagreement with peers and thus a higher predicted chance of error. The score is graded, so it keeps more information than a yes/no majority vote.</p>');
      take = 'This candidate scores ' + f3(info.c) + ': ' + (info.c >= 0.5 ? 'most peers disagree with it.' : 'a majority of peers agree with it.');
    } else {
      const lab = me.lab;
      html = col('The label', '<p><span class="lab ' + lab + '">' + lab + '</span> tier ' + rec.tier + (rec.ops ? '<br>Repair operations: ' + rec.ops.map(o => '<span class="chip">' + esc(o) + '</span>').join('') : '') + '</p><p class="note">Labels come from the Z3 labeller against a trusted reference (tier A) or the blind panel (tier B).</p>')
        + col('Consensus vs the judge', '<div class="meter"><span>Consensus</span><span class="bar"><i style="width:' + (100 * rec.c) + '%;background:' + C.accent + '"></i></span><b>' + f3(rec.c) + '</b></div><div class="meter"><span>Flash-Lite judge (disguised)</span><span class="bar"><i style="width:' + (100 * rec.jd) + '%;background:' + C.baseDark + '"></i></span><b>' + f3(rec.jd) + '</b></div><p class="note">Both are oriented so that higher means more likely wrong.</p>')
        + col('Why it matters', '<p>' + (which === 'err' ? 'The candidate turns the one-way rule "if powered and battery, then electric vehicle" into an if-and-only-if. The judge rates it as faithful; most peers do not write it that way, so consensus flags it.' : 'The correct candidate sits in the largest agreeing group, so its score is low. It is not zero: some correct peers wrote the rule in a nested form the aligned check did not prove equivalent, which is the divergence d discussed under Where it fails.') + '</p>');
      take = which === 'err' ? 'Consensus gives this wrong translation ' + f3(rec.c) + ' while the disguised judge gives it ' + f3(rec.jd) + ': the peers catch what the judge passes.' : 'Consensus gives this correct translation ' + f3(rec.c) + ', below the wrong one’s ' + f3(recOf(CAND.err).c) + ', which is the ordering AUROC rewards.';
    }
    body.innerHTML = html;
    wireTerms(body);
    $('#s-take').textContent = take;
  }
  function go(i) { cur = Math.max(0, Math.min(STAGES.length - 1, i)); render(); }
  $('#s-prev').addEventListener('click', () => go(cur - 1));
  $('#s-next').addEventListener('click', () => go(cur + 1));
  $('#stepper').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.target.matches('input, select, textarea')) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { go(cur + 1); e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { go(cur - 1); e.preventDefault(); }
  });
  $$('input[name=scand]').forEach(i => i.addEventListener('change', render));
  render(); onResize($('#pipeline'), drawPipe);
})();

/* ---------- 3a. Complexity ---------- */
(function complexity() {
  const BINS = {
    words: { f: s => s.words, bins: [[0, 12, '<12'], [12, 20, '12–19'], [20, 25, '20–24'], [25, 35, '25–34'], [35, 1e9, '≥35']], unit: 'words' },
    ncond: { f: s => s.ncond, bins: [[-1, 2, '≤1'], [2, 3, '2'], [3, 4, '3'], [4, 1e9, '4+']], unit: 'conditions' },
    nquant: { f: s => s.nquant, bins: [[-1, 2, '0–1'], [2, 3, '2'], [3, 1e9, '3+']], unit: 'quantifiers' },
    depth: { f: s => s.depth, bins: [[-1, 3.5, '≤3'], [3.5, 4.5, '4'], [4.5, 1e9, '>4']], unit: 'depth' },
    exc: { cat: s => s.exc || 'none', unit: 'exception' }
  };
  const box = $('#c-cx');
  function draw() {
    const dim = $('#cx-dim').value, base = $('#cx-base').value;
    $('#cx-base-name').textContent = MNAME[base];
    const B = BINS[dim];
    let cells;
    if (B.cat) {
      const cats = {};
      R.forEach(r => { const c = B.cat(r.sent); (cats[c] = cats[c] || []).push(r); });
      cells = Object.entries(cats).sort((a, b) => b[1].length - a[1].length).map(([k, rows]) => ({ label: k.replace('_', ' '), rows }));
    } else {
      cells = B.bins.map(([lo, hi, lab]) => ({ label: lab + ' ' + B.unit, rows: R.filter(r => B.f(r.sent) >= lo && B.f(r.sent) < hi) }));
    }
    const groups = cells.map(cl => {
      const ne = cl.rows.filter(r => r.y).length, nc = cl.rows.length - ne;
      const thin = ne < 10 || nc < 10;
      const a = auroc(cl.rows, 'c'), b = auroc(cl.rows, base);
      cl.a = a; cl.b = b; cl.thin = thin; cl.ne = ne; cl.nc = nc;
      const sub = 'n = ' + cl.rows.length + ' (' + ne + ' err / ' + nc + ' cor)' + (thin ? ', thin' : '') + (a != null && b != null ? ', Δ ' + sgn(a - b) : '');
      const mk = (v, name, color) => ({ value: v, color, faint: thin, tip: '<b>' + esc(cl.label) + '</b><br>' + name + ': AUROC ' + f3(v) + '<br>' + ne + ' errors, ' + nc + ' correct', aria: cl.label + ', ' + name + ': AUROC ' + f3(v) });
      return { label: cl.label, sub, bars: [mk(a, 'Consensus', C.accent), mk(b, MNAME[base], C.base)] };
    });
    hbars(box, groups, { xLabel: 'Pooled AUROC within bin (0.5 = chance)', ref: 0.5, barH: 14, title: 'AUROC by complexity bin' });
    const ok = cells.filter(c => !c.thin && c.a != null && c.b != null);
    if (ok.length) {
      const best = ok.reduce((p, q) => (q.a - q.b > p.a - p.b ? q : p));
      const worst = ok.reduce((p, q) => (q.a - q.b < p.a - p.b ? q : p));
      $('#cx-take').textContent = 'Against ' + MNAME[base] + ', consensus gains most in the ' + best.label + ' bin (' + sgn(best.a - best.b) + ') and least in ' + worst.label + ' (' + sgn(worst.a - worst.b) + ').' + (worst.a - worst.b < 0 ? ' There the baseline is ahead.' : '');
    }
  }
  $('#cx-dim').addEventListener('change', draw); $('#cx-base').addEventListener('change', draw);
  draw(); onResize(box, draw);
})();

/* ---------- 3b. Item browser ---------- */
const browser = (function () {
  const opCount = {};
  R.forEach(r => (r.ops || []).forEach(o => { opCount[o] = (opCount[o] || 0) + 1; }));
  const opSel = $('#b-op');
  Object.entries(opCount).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).forEach(([o, n]) => { const op = document.createElement('option'); op.value = o; op.textContent = o + ' (' + n + ')'; opSel.appendChild(op); });
  let shown = 40, filtered = [], selected = null;
  const flagC = r => r.c >= 0.5, flagJ = r => r.jd >= 0.5;
  function apply() {
    const lab = $('#b-label').value, st = $('#b-strat').value, ag = $('#b-agree').value, op = $('#b-op').value, q = $('#b-q').value.trim().toLowerCase(), so = $('#b-sort').value;
    filtered = R.filter(r => (lab === 'all' || String(r.y) === lab) && (st === 'all' || r.st === st) && (op === 'all' || (r.ops || []).includes(op))
      && (ag === 'all' || (ag === 'cOnly' && flagC(r) && !flagJ(r)) || (ag === 'jOnly' && !flagC(r) && flagJ(r)) || (ag === 'both' && flagC(r) && flagJ(r)) || (ag === 'none' && !flagC(r) && !flagJ(r)))
      && (!q || r.sent.text.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.me.fol.toLowerCase().includes(q)));
    const cmp = { 'c-desc': (a, b) => b.c - a.c || a.i - b.i, 'c-asc': (a, b) => a.c - b.c || a.i - b.i, gap: (a, b) => (b.c - b.jd) - (a.c - a.jd) || a.i - b.i, words: (a, b) => b.sent.words - a.sent.words || a.i - b.i }[so];
    filtered.sort(cmp);
    shown = 40;
    renderList();
    const ne = filtered.filter(r => r.y).length, nc = filtered.length - ne;
    $('#b-count').textContent = filtered.length.toLocaleString() + ' matching candidates (' + ne + ' errors, ' + nc + ' correct) from ' + new Set(filtered.map(r => r.s)).size + ' sentences.';
    const a = auroc(filtered, 'c'), b = auroc(filtered, 'jd');
    let t;
    if (!filtered.length) t = 'No candidate matches these filters.';
    else if (a != null && b != null) t = 'On this selection consensus separates errors from correct candidates with AUROC ' + f3(a) + ', the disguised judge with ' + f3(b) + ' (' + sgn(a - b) + ').';
    else t = 'This selection holds only ' + (ne ? 'errors' : 'correct candidates') + ': consensus flags ' + pct(filtered.filter(flagC).length / filtered.length) + ' of them, the judge ' + pct(filtered.filter(flagJ).length / filtered.length) + '.';
    $('#b-take').textContent = t;
    if (!selected || !filtered.includes(selected)) select(filtered[0] || null, false);
  }
  function renderList() {
    const ul = $('#b-list'); ul.innerHTML = '';
    filtered.slice(0, shown).forEach(r => {
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button';
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', r === selected ? 'true' : 'false');
      b.innerHTML = '<span class="lab ' + (r.y ? 'ERROR' : 'CORRECT') + '">' + (r.y ? 'ERROR' : 'CORRECT') + '</span> <span class="chip">' + r.st + '</span> <span class="chip">' + esc(famName(r.me.fam)) + '</span><span class="t">' + esc(r.sent.text) + '</span><span class="scores"><span>consensus ' + f3(r.c) + '</span><span>judge ' + f3(r.jd) + '</span></span>';
      b.addEventListener('click', () => select(r, true));
      li.appendChild(b); ul.appendChild(li);
    });
    const more = $('#b-more');
    more.hidden = shown >= filtered.length;
    more.textContent = 'Show ' + Math.min(40, filtered.length - shown) + ' more (' + (filtered.length - shown) + ' left)';
  }
  function select(r, focus) {
    selected = r;
    $$('#b-list button').forEach((b, i) => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', filtered[i] === r ? 'true' : 'false'));
    const d = $('#b-detail');
    if (!r) { d.innerHTML = '<p>No candidate selected.</p>'; return; }
    const info = peerInfo(r.sent, r.me);
    const meter = (name, v, color, flag) => '<div class="meter"><span>' + name + '</span><span class="bar"><i style="width:' + (100 * v) + '%;background:' + color + '"></i></span><b>' + f3(v) + '</b></div>';
    const verdict = (f, name) => name + (f ? ' flags it' : ' passes it');
    d.innerHTML = '<h4 style="margin-top:0">Sentence <span class="chip">' + r.st + '</span><span class="chip">' + r.sent.words + ' words</span><span class="chip">' + r.sent.ncond + ' conditions</span></h4><div class="sent">' + esc(r.sent.text) + '</div>'
      + '<div class="detail-grid"><div><h4>Candidate (' + esc(rowTag(r.me)) + ')</h4><div class="fol">' + esc(r.me.fol) + '</div><p style="margin:6px 0"><span class="lab ' + (r.y ? 'ERROR' : 'CORRECT') + '">' + (r.y ? 'ERROR' : 'CORRECT') + '</span> tier ' + r.tier + ' ' + (r.ops ? r.ops.map(o => '<span class="chip">' + esc(o) + '</span>').join('') : '') + '</p></div>'
      + '<div><h4>Scores (higher = more likely wrong)</h4>' + meter('Consensus', r.c, C.accent) + meter('Flash-Lite judge (disguised)', r.jd, C.baseDark) + meter('Flash-Lite judge (original)', r.jo, C.base) + meter('PEER+TEXT', r.pt, C.accent) + '<p class="note">' + verdict(flagC(r), 'Consensus') + '; ' + verdict(flagJ(r), 'the disguised judge').toLowerCase() + '.</p></div></div>'
      + '<h4>Peers: ' + info.k + ' of ' + info.P.length + ' proved equivalent, so c-score = 1 − ' + info.k + '/' + info.P.length + ' = ' + f3(info.c) + '</h4>'
      + '<ul class="peerlist">' + info.list.filter(x => x.p !== r.me).map(x => {
        const v = x.why ? '<span class="v out" aria-label="excluded">–</span>' : x.eq ? '<span class="v yes" aria-label="equivalent">✓</span>' : '<span class="v no" aria-label="not equivalent">✗</span>';
        return '<li class="' + (x.why ? 'dim' : '') + '">' + v + '<div><span style="font-weight:600">' + esc(rowTag(x.p)) + '</span> <span class="lab ' + x.p.lab + '">' + x.p.lab + '</span>' + (x.why ? ' <span class="note">(' + x.why + ')</span>' : '') + '<div class="fol">' + esc(x.p.fol) + '</div></div></li>';
      }).join('') + '</ul>';
    if (focus && window.innerWidth < 860) d.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
  }
  ['#b-label', '#b-strat', '#b-agree', '#b-op', '#b-sort'].forEach(s => $(s).addEventListener('change', apply));
  $('#b-q').addEventListener('input', apply);

  apply();
  return {
    open(r) {
      $('#b-label').value = 'all'; $('#b-strat').value = 'all'; $('#b-agree').value = 'all'; $('#b-op').value = 'all'; $('#b-q').value = '';

      if (btn) { btn.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }); btn.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }
    }
  };
})();

/* ---------- 3c. Scatter ---------- */
(function scatter() {
  const box = $('#c-scatter');
  function draw() {
    const cut = $('#m-cut').value;
    const rows = MECH.scatter.filter(r => {
      if (cut === 'all') return true;
      const [k, v] = cut.split(':');
      return (k === 'st' && r.stratum === v) || (k === 'wt' && r.words_t === v) || (k === 'nc' && r.ncond === v);
    });
    const cor = rows.map(r => r.si_cor).filter(v => v != null), err = rows.map(r => r.si_err).filter(v => v != null);
    const bin = v => Math.min(9, Math.floor(v * 10 + 1e-9));
    const hist = arr => { const h = new Array(10).fill(0); arr.forEach(v => h[bin(v)]++); return h.map(x => arr.length ? 100 * x / arr.length : 0); };
    const hc = hist(cor), he = hist(err);
    const labels = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => (i / 10).toFixed(1) + (i === 9 ? '–1' : ''));
    const ymax = Math.max(10, Math.ceil(Math.max(...hc, ...he) / 10) * 10);
    const yt = []; for (let t = 0; t <= ymax; t += ymax > 50 ? 20 : 10) yt.push(t);

I've built `interactive.html` (1.4 MB, one self-contained file) and linked it from `index.html`. The last run in the headless browser showed no console errors and no sideways scrolling at 390 px or 1440 px, with every control operated by real clicks and taps.

**What the page shows.** Every chart is drawn in the browser from the run's actual per-candidate records: all 2,686 primary candidates, the equivalence checks between their peer translations, and the recorded confidence intervals and tables. The headline numbers it computes match the paper: consensus 0.741 against 0.642 for the pre-registered judge, a gap of +0.099 [+0.049, +0.146], and all 10 AUROC pairs in Table 1. It also reproduces the scatter-index results (0.760 vs 0.159, ratio 4.45×).

**The sections, top to bottom:**
- **The finding:** the +0.099 gap, plus a bar chart of 10 metrics you can switch by stratum or restrict to tier A labels.
- **How it works:** a five-stage walk through one real sentence, where you pick the wrong or the correct candidate. It shows each peer translation and whether Z3 proved it equivalent, then recomputes the score. The recomputed scores match the stored ones (0.900 and 0.364).
- **Explore the evidence:**
  - the consensus-vs-judge gap by sentence complexity;
  - an item browser with filters and search, showing a candidate beside all its peer translations;
  - the scatter histogram;
  - accuracy against the number of model families;
  - per-error-type accuracy with a DOWN/UP switch.
- **Try a threshold:** a slider over the recorded consensus scores that recounts recall and false alarms, with ROC curves. A live demo isn't possible because the method needs LLM calls and the solver.
- **Where it fails:** errors most peers agree with, and correct translations most peers reject, each with five real cases that open in the browser. Then the paper's own limitations.

**Things you should know:**
- **Table 2 doesn't match the data.** For every metric except consensus, the per-error-type values in the paper's Table 2 differ from the experiment's per-operator file. The page shows the file's values and only quotes the numbers that match: the consensus row and the overall column. The table in the paper is worth checking.
- **The judge threshold comparison is approximate.** The judge's recorded scores come in a few coarse steps, so it can't be held to exactly the same false-alarm rate as consensus. The page shows the judge's nearest achievable cutoff and says so; comparing at an exact rate made the judge read 0%.
- **The family-count chart stops at 7 families.** The run's table only goes up to 7, while the paper says 9. The page doesn't claim 9.
- **No paper figures are shown.** All three are data plots the page now draws live.
- **No author line.** The paper's author field is empty, so the page has none.

Other files touched: `index.html` gained only the two "Explore the interactive demo" links, in the hero and the footer.
